<thought>To locate a retrosynthetic template for a Diels‑Alder reaction, I will search the template catalog using the allowed functional‑group name for a carbon‑carbon double bond (“C‑C double bonds”). The reaction breaks a C=C bond (the dienophile) and forms new C‑C single bonds, which is captured by specifying “C‑C double bonds” as a broken functional group and “C‑C” as a formed functional group. This should return a Diels‑Alder template that I can use for the single‑step retrosynthesis.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
